import bpy
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(radius=0.5, location=(0, 0, 1.5))
s = bpy.context.active_object
s.name = 'Ball'
m = bpy.data.materials.new('Red')
m.use_nodes = True
next(n for n in m.node_tree.nodes if n.type == 'BSDF_PRINCIPLED').inputs['Base Color'].default_value = (1, 0, 0, 1)
s.data.materials.append(m)
print('ok')
